oracle_boundary: Fixture supplies one correct offered candidate by unique catalog name/role; actual scoped binding, TaskPatch validation, reducer, state and logical compiler run. This is not model accuracy.
verified_effects: Existing metric collection REPLACE deletes all old metrics and retains only the selected metric.
Existing dimension REPLACE deletes the old dimension and preserves metrics.
Explicit singleton and one-element array yield identical materialized collection semantics.
ADD retains previous values whereas REPLACE removes them.
Foreign/raw/extra authority, wrong roles/evidence, null/string values and wrong operations still reject.
Initial assignment and SET singleton rejection are unchanged; no task or operation is inferred.

latest_stage.method: Intervene on independently reviewed model-output fields; run real pin/restore/TaskPatch/reducer/compiler. Later model outputs remain recorded, not newly generated under changed context.

governed_time_stage.intervention: Remove redundant subject marker/slot and draft assignment only; original mentions, offered handles and raw TimeSpec retained
